llm_top3.reasoning: I deviate from the top quant ranks because the strongest news catalysts sit lower in the list: PBI combines a Q2 beat, raised guidance, debt reduction and an active strategic review that could culminate in a full sale near $22, giving asymmetric upside; LTH has a raised 2026 outlook plus a Goldman buy initiation and a broad sweep of price-target hikes with momentum confirmed at new highs. ARES pairs a solid quant rank with record $36B fundraising and 17% AUM growth. I passed on top-ranked BEN and WY (good but already-digested beats, valuation flags, and softer Q3 guidance for WY) and avoided EIX/ES on wildfire-reform and charge-driven downside.

BEN.reasoning: Q3 beat with record $1.8T AUM and $18.4B long-term net inflows plus rebrand and expanded credit facility, though GF Value flags overvaluation.

WY.reasoning: Q2 earnings/sales beat with higher lumber prices and a Raymond James upgrade to strong buy, tempered by guidance for slightly lower Q3 EBITDA and housing weakness.

AEE.reasoning: Q2 EPS up 12%, reaffirmed guidance, $71B data-center-anchored investment pipeline and a JPMorgan target hike to $137.

LYV.reasoning: Strong Q2 beat with record attendance and raised outlook plus multiple PT hikes, but shares fell ~5% on FCF margin compression, capex and Ticketmaster antitrust overhang.

AMCR.reasoning: Mostly routine 13F reductions plus BofA noting lackluster packaging demand and weak volumes; earnings still ahead.

ARES.reasoning: Record $36B quarterly fundraising and AUM up 17% to $671B with in-line EPS and slight revenue miss; private-credit default/redemption concerns are a modest offset.

PBI.reasoning: Q2 beat, raised 2026 guidance, $201M debt reduction and a second-phase strategic review including a possible full sale, with Citizens raising target to $22.

LIN.reasoning: Record Q2 sales/EPS, record $8.1B electronics backlog and a Jefferies target hike to $560, but shares slid on margin slippage, Lincare's growing ~$130M drag and light guidance.

COO.reasoning: Headline set is mostly unrelated COO-title insider sales; the relevant items are a Citigroup target raise to $76 and a positive post-earnings reaction against APAC softness.

PFG.reasoning: Q2 operating EPS $2.50 up 16% with dividend hike and buyback, plus reported takeover interest in Voya where PFG is a suitor; BofA downgrade to Underperform is an offset.

LTH.reasoning: Raised 2026 outlook, Goldman buy initiation and a wave of price-target hikes (RBC $60, Mizuho $64, KeyBanc $52) with the stock at fresh highs on club/MIORA expansion.

KKR.reasoning: Announced $5.7B all-cash take-private of Integer, a 50% stake purchase in TotalEnergies' 1.2GW European renewables and a record $19.2B infrastructure fund.

FHN.reasoning: Q2 EPS $0.55 up ~20% with revenue growth, Cramer buy endorsement and analyst views of 45% undervaluation, though shares initially fell on the beat.

ES.reasoning: Q2 GAAP EPS collapsed 85% on Aquarion sale and offshore wind charges and Eversource missed both earnings and revenue estimates, only partly offset by reaffirmed 5-7% growth.

EIX.reasoning: Barclays downgrade to Equal Weight, revenue miss, and CEO warning of credit downgrades if California wildfire liability reform fails by Aug 31 outweigh the EPS beat.

TROW.reasoning: EPS beat on record $1.89T AUM but revenue missed and shares fell ~6% amid continued active equity outflows and a cautious second-half outlook.

FSLR.reasoning: Big Q2 EPS beat ($3.92 vs $2.99), 57% gross margin and $13.6B backlog driving a breakout, though several analysts cut price targets and a death cross was flagged.

KEY.reasoning: Mostly generic 'key' keyword noise; genuine KeyCorp items are a Q2 EPS beat, 52-week high and routine 2027 earnings-call scheduling.

CL.reasoning: Q2 EPS beat with 4.9% sales growth and margin expansion but revenue near/below consensus, weak North America and flat gross margin guidance sent shares down ~2%.

UDR.reasoning: Q2 FFO and revenue beat with raised 2026 guidance and a shift to monthly dividends, offset by a Wall Street Zen downgrade and Sunbelt softness.
